kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ابتغيت (form VIII)
# اِبْتَغَيْتُ (ibtaḡaytu) /ib.ta.ɣaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# اِبْتَغَيْتَ (ibtaḡayta) /ib.ta.ɣaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# اِبْتَغَيْتِ (ibtaḡayti) /ib.ta.ɣaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# اُبْتُغِيتُ (ubtuḡītu) /ub.tu.ɣiː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
